rows.text: ## Inputs, state and ordering
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
At most24 ordered steps. Originals carry nondecreasing developmental phase0..4,
not biological years; a controlled developmental source, never practice count.
Immutable profile: Step or Ramp gain, independent learning/formation enables,
constitution-1/0/+1. Separate state: current developmental phase, procedural skill,
fallible performance estimate/support count, original qualification journal,
personality accumulator and event-time formation entries. Empty skill/journal;
belief absent. No caller may inject acquired state. Constitution never changes.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Each step admits developmental phase; derives gains; constructs a single adopted
exercise plan/attempt when requested; executes using PRIOR competence and physical
permission/difficulty; independently admits a controlled performance report; resolves
an actual inherited Task choice where available; freezes expression and qualification;
then updates acquired state atomically. Later updates never change prior execution.
Decision consumes only prior personality, constitution and accepted task context.
Physical permission and reported performance cannot enter its reasons.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text: ## Candidate mathematics
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Step gain g(d)=4 for d<2, otherwise1. Ramp gain g(d)=1+3*(4-d)/4.
Disabling either developmental route fixes only that route's gain to1.
Actual permitted practice updates skill K'=min(1,K+gLearning/8). Exercise success
is attempted AND permitted AND prior K>=difficulty; difficulty is integer0..8
divided by8. Practice can occur after a failed attempt. No opportunity/permission
means no practice. A report may be false or absent independently of outcome.
Only an attempted permitted exercise admits a present report. First report creates
known0 or1; subsequent B'=B+(report-B)*gLearning/8. Missing is not known zero.
This bounded evidence filter is a candidate learning law, not calibrated confidence.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Personality uses unchanged dispositionDecision/Threshold qualification and original
identity append semantics. Training decisions use zero acquired feedback as a
controlled exposure-matching fixture; probes use prior personality feedback through
the inherited fine1/16 reason units. Original constitutional contribution remains1/8
times constitution. Personality updates only for eligible training contributions c:
P'=clamp(P+c*gFormation/4,-1/2,+1/2). Store at, developmental phase, c, gain and actual
applied delta. Do not multiply authorship, alter eligibility or change the original
qualification journal. This separate accumulator alone feeds personality reasons;
original identity standing is not added again. No assertion that both stores are
irreducible. Later age changes do not recompute event gains; contrary later evidence
can change P. Probe qualifications cannot learn. Trivial/pressured opportunities
retain ordinary decisions but fail existing eligibility. Forced movement has no
authored choice/expression/qualification; requested physical movement may still occur.

rows.text:
Canonical component save commits profile/originals and all state/log; restore starts
empty and reexecutes the admitted prefix, never installs parsed state. Guard pending
settlement reads/overlap; failed precommit injection leaves prior bytes intact.

interventions are required. Same mature endpoint must preserve early-versus-late
formation differences. Keep Step/Ramp, each gain disabled/both disabled, constant
young/mature, constitutional controls, blocked/absent practice, false/absent reports,
trivial/pressure/force, saturation, later correction and all declared seeds.

LOCAL DISPOSITION, development-public/0.1-candidate, 2026-10-01.
Implements development-component/0.1-candidate without changing its candidate laws.
Records1493..1508/schema1; occurrence namespace1155 reused for exact inherited task
lineage. Constitution1457/1453 and journal1436/1435 reused in this model scope.
No predecessor schema, law, allocation or receipt changes. Counters1508/16.

rows.text:
Originals are closed typed profile1493 and ordered frame1494,1..24 instants. Phase0..4
is nondecreasing; same checks as the component. S0 has original first phase, zero skill,
unknown belief/support0, empty qualification and formation history, zero personality,
and immutable constitution. No acquired-state admission. Run seed is fixed zero32;
frame seed is the committed inherited task seed, not a new random-stream law.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Thirteen native handlers run each instant: development30, context40, reasons52,
decision60, intent70, expression80, exercise100, execution110, report120, qualify130,
learning140, identity140, formation140. Same-phase identity precedes its formation
child. Learning and identity are independent. Source routing authenticates the original
at development30; generated children authenticate complete scheduled bytes and parent.
Every branch reserves one runtime slot and emits its declared stages, including no-op.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Sole writers: development->phase1500; learning->skill1501 and belief1502;
identity->journal1436; formation->personality/history1503. No constitution writer.
Reasons read constitution/journal/personality; learning reads phase/skill/belief;
formation reads phase/personality and receives actual qualification from identity.
Physical execution reads prior skill; it sends only practice/opportunity and the
independent supplied report to report120. Cognition never receives actual success.
Task permission is independent of exercise permission, as in the frozen component.
Training holds acquired feedback zero; probes consume personality. Forced movement
has no task expression. No phase update directly writes acquired state.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Use existing dispositionReasons/arbitrate and task intent/expression/qualification,
with exact inherited occurrence IDs and RNG addresses. Stage outputs and trace carry
actual producers, patches, reads and children. Pending RNG addresses publish only on
successful settlement. A failed instant rolls back whole state, queue, allocators,
outputs, traces and committed random ledger, and makes the runtime Failed.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

rows.text:
Learning: practice adds gain/8 capped1; first report initializes known0/1; subsequent
reports interpolate by gain/8. Support counts admitted reports. Formation adds eligible
contribution*gain/4, clamped[-1/2,1/2], preserving event-time phase/gain/applied delta.
Gains Step/Ramp and independent disable flags are exactly the component's laws.
Records1504..1507 expose actual execution, safe report, learning and formation results.
1508 is a diagnostic assembled row, not a writable character leaf or cognitive input.
Character projection excludes physical executed/forcedExecuted fields. No clinical,
calendar-age, universal plasticity or new eligibility claim.
rows.judgment: Same bounded contract text in preserved development cohort; earlier whole-contract review applies to content. Archive context preserves the original attempted cohort, not independent successful qualification. No added model/run coverage.

Public factory admits copied byte sources behind opaque model handles. Actual Save132
contains native state, queue, trace, allocators and committed RNG ledger. Restore parses
structure only, recreates empty S0 from originals, replays complete13-stage instants,
and requires exact whole-save equality. Runtime and factory publication are guarded
through promise settlement. Tests must cover exact component rows/bundles/RNG, wrong
writers, every reached stage fault, original lineage, malformed admissions, mutation,
restore and public barriers. Full36-program/668-prefix matrix is mandatory before
native qualification. One actual successor per prefix, not every full tail.
